nodes.label: FPGA Development Guidelines
nodes.rationale: FPGA development guidelines covering Vivado, SystemVerilog, modular design, timing closure, AXI interfaces, and hardware optimization.

nodes.label: Synchronous Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Prioritize single clock domains to simplify timing analysis, favor synchronous reset over asynchronous reset for predictable behavior, and use synchronizers or FIFOs for safe clock domain crossing.

nodes.label: Timing Closure and Constraints
nodes.rationale: Establish XDC timing constraints early, review Static Timing Analysis reports, and resolve violations via pipeline stages, logic optimization, or multi-cycle path constraints.

nodes.label: Resource and Power Optimization
nodes.rationale: Optimize LUTs, FFs, and BRAM (including reg[] RAM inference), use Vivado IP cores (AXI, DSP, memory controllers), and apply clock gating and power-aware synthesis.

nodes.label: FPGA Simulation and ILA Verification
nodes.rationale: Use self-checking testbenches, SystemVerilog assertions, behavioral and post-synthesis simulation, and Integrated Logic Analyzer (ILA) probing for real-time debugging.

nodes.label: AXI, DMA, and Latency Optimization
nodes.rationale: Ensure AXI read/write handshake compliance, configure DMA burst transfers for throughput, and place fine-tuned pipeline stages to balance latency vs. throughput.

nodes.label: VslamCihuyy Integration Stage Workflow
nodes.rationale: Integrates existing .sv modules on Kria K26 SOM (PL SystemVerilog + ARM PS) under Windows PowerShell without rewriting working modules: build integration map first, then verify pairwise, subsystem, and top.

nodes.label: Integration Map Protocol
nodes.rationale: Before connecting modules, read rtl/ and tb/ sources and document exact parameters, ports, fixed-point formats, clocks/resets, handshakes, latency, throughput, data path, and testbench results in docs/integration.md, marking unknowns explicitly.

nodes.label: Open Parameters Policy
nodes.rationale: Keep undecided camera/sensor, resolution, frame rate, interface, IMU, dataset, clock frequency, and fixed-point formats parameterized and log labeled provisional defaults in docs/integration.md instead of guessing.

nodes.label: SystemVerilog Integration Coding Rules
nodes.rationale: Enforce default_nettype none/wire, logic, latch-free always_ff/always_comb, typedef enum FSMs, shared rtl/pkg/ packages, named port connections, explicit Qm.n comments and saturate/wrap choice, single clock domain per module with documented CDC, and valid-independent-of-ready handshakes.

nodes.label: Simulation Harness and Error Checklist
nodes.rationale: Maintain dependency compile order in scripts/rtl.f, run self-checking testbenches (TB_RESULT: PASS/FAIL via iverilog or Vivado xsim via scripts/run_all.ps1), and review against port, fixed-point, timing, control, CDC, RTL hygiene, BRAM, and VSLAM-specific checks.

nodes.label: VslamCihuyy ORB Front-End Architecture
nodes.rationale: Implements ORB feature extraction and matching in PL on Kria KV260 while tracking, local BA, and loop closing run on ARM PS in ORB-SLAM3; organizes stages under hw/<stage>/ with shared 600x350 EuRoC test frames.

nodes.label: ORB-SLAM3 Golden Model and PS Backend
nodes.rationale: ORB-SLAM3 runs tracking, local BA, and loop closing on the ARM PS and serves as the bit-exact golden reference for every PL hardware stage.

nodes.label: EuRoC MH_01_easy 600x350 PGM Test Frames
nodes.rationale: Stores small 8-bit PGM frames resized to 600x350 (monocular EuRoC.yaml size) in data/frames/ so every hardware stage tests on identical inputs while full EuRoC sequences remain outside git.

nodes.label: Extractor-Output Record and Frame Header Contract
nodes.rationale: Draft integration contract handed between extraction stages, the matcher, and ARM PS; tracks open team decisions on keypoint coordinate format, score width/retention, angle format, descriptor bit order, candidate cap, and frame bookkeeping.

nodes.label: FAST-9 Corner Detector Stage (hw/fast)
nodes.rationale: FAST-9 corner detection (cv::FAST) per 35 px cell with threshold 20 and retry at 7 plus NMS, bit-exact with ORB-SLAM3 on EuRoC; owned by Fadhly.

nodes.label: ORB Front-End Top Stage (hw/frontend_top)
nodes.rationale: Integrates all ORB front-end stages into the top-level hardware design with an end-to-end testbench against the full golden model.

nodes.label: 7x7 Gaussian Blur Stage (hw/gaussian)
nodes.rationale: 7x7 Gaussian blur (sigma=2) applied to each pyramid level before rBRIEF, bit-exact with ORB-SLAM3 on EuRoC; owned by Fadhly.

nodes.label: Descriptor Matcher Stage (hw/matcher)
nodes.rationale: Bit-exact port of ORB-SLAM3 SearchForInitialization with Vitis HLS (hls/) and SystemVerilog (rtl/) implementations; owned by Zaki.

nodes.label: Keypoint Orientation Stage (hw/orientation)
nodes.rationale: Keypoint orientation by intensity centroid over a radius-15 circular patch (bit-exact with ORB-SLAM3 IC_Angle); owned by Raegrand.

nodes.label: Image Pyramid Stage (hw/pyramid)
nodes.rationale: 8-level image pyramid with scale factor 1.2 and bilinear resize of 600x350 input (bit-exact with ORB-SLAM3 ComputePyramid); owned by Timothy.

nodes.label: rBRIEF Descriptor Stage (hw/rbrief)
nodes.rationale: 256-bit rBRIEF descriptor using 256 learned point pairs rotated by keypoint angle where bit = I(a) < I(b), bit-exact with ORB-SLAM3 on EuRoC; owned by Kenny.

nodes.label: VslamCihuyy Integration Map
nodes.rationale: First-session module catalog, data path, testbench baseline, and open parameter table built from RTL/TB sources; identifies src/verilog/orient/ as canonical and six hw/ stages as stubs.

nodes.label: pipelined_adder_tree Specification
nodes.rationale: Generic pipelined adder tree with one register stage per tree level (latency ceil(log2(N)), 1 result/clock throughput) and no reset or handshake.

nodes.label: orient_linebuf Specification
nodes.rationale: 37-row BRAM line buffer (read-first simple dual port, 2-clock latency) storing 36 history rows per column and outputting 37x1 columns on pix_valid with active-low synchronous reset.

nodes.label: orient_colsum Specification
nodes.rationale: 7-clock column aggregator computing S(C) (Q14.0 unsigned) and m01(C) (Q19.0 signed) via symmetry trick and two pipelined_adder_tree instances with 1-clock alignment delay on S.

nodes.label: orient_moments Specification
nodes.rationale: 2-clock sliding-window recursive moment accumulator with 37-deep delay line producing m00 (Q19.0 unsigned) and mirrored-frame m10/m01 (Q22.0 signed).

nodes.label: orient_quantizer Specification
nodes.rationale: 4-clock pipelined angle discretizer mapping (m10, m01) to (quadrant[1:0], sector[3:0]) over 64 sectors using Q5.8 tangent table comparators in orient_tan_table.svh.

nodes.label: orient_core Specification
nodes.rationale: 15-clock streaming orientation pipeline chaining linebuf, colsum, moments, and quantizer; emits valid windows for cur_row>=36 and cur_col>=36 with sideband coordinate tags.

nodes.label: kp_fifo Specification
nodes.rationale: 0-read-latency synchronous FWFT FIFO (depth 64 default) buffering keypoint coordinates with MSB wrap-around full detection and synchronous flush.

nodes.label: kp_match Specification
nodes.rationale: 1-clock registered raster-order matcher comparing finished orient_core windows against kp_fifo head and popping matched or stale keypoints (relying on FAST delivering keypoints before window completion).

nodes.label: orient_top Specification
nodes.rationale: 16-clock orientation wrapper combining orient_core, kp_fifo, and kp_match with 18-pixel border filtering and valid/ready keypoint input.

nodes.label: Intended Top-Level ORB Data Path
nodes.rationale: Data path from Camera -> pyramid -> (gaussian, fast) -> orient_top -> rbrief -> matcher -> ARM PS, feeding smoothed pixels and oriented keypoints in parallel to rBRIEF.

nodes.label: Orientation Testbench Results and Known Issues
nodes.rationale: tb_orient passes in iverilog 12 (gap=0 and gap=40: 1680/1680 windows, 60/60 keypoints); flags stale files.f paths, incomplete hw/orientation/rtl mirror, non-self-checking tb_patch, and missing TB_RESULT prefix.

nodes.label: Open Parameters and Fixed-Point Registry
nodes.rationale: Catalogs undecided parameters (camera interface, 96x64 vs 640x480 resolution, frame rate, clock frequency, descriptor bit order, candidate cap, frame bookkeeping) alongside established orientation Q-formats.

nodes.label: Pairwise Integration Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Sequences pairwise integration starting with Gaussian->orient_top and FAST->orient_top after fixing stale files.f paths, consolidating duplicate orientation RTL copies, and standardizing TB_RESULT verdicts.
